facts.fact: AdImpact projects $10.8 billion in total political ad spending for the 2026 midterms.
facts.quote: AdImpact projects $10.8 billion in total political ad spending for the 2026 midterms, with $2.5 billion flowing to CTV and streaming alone.

facts.fact: A GRP measures the percentage of a target audience reached multiplied by the frequency of exposure.
facts.quote: A GRP measures the percentage of your target audience reached, multiplied by the frequency of exposure.

facts.fact: The page gives a typical awareness-phase political broadcast target of 200-400 GRPs per week to build name recognition.
facts.quote: **Awareness phase:** 200-400 GRPs per week to build name recognition

facts.fact: The page gives a typical persuasion-phase political broadcast target of 400-600 GRPs per week to move opinion.
facts.quote: **Persuasion phase:** 400-600 GRPs per week to move opinion

facts.fact: The page gives a typical GOTV (Get Out The Vote) broadcast target of 600-1,000+ GRPs per week for maximum saturation.
facts.quote: **GOTV (Get Out The Vote):** 600-1,000+ GRPs per week for maximum saturation

facts.fact: The page recommends an optimal frequency of 8-12 impressions per household over a political CTV campaign cycle.
facts.unit: impressions per household per campaign cycle
facts.quote: the optimal frequency range is 8-12 impressions per household over a campaign cycle.

facts.fact: The page states that below 5 impressions per household the message does not stick, and above 15 the campaign hits diminishing returns.
facts.quote: Below 5, the message doesn't stick. Above 15, you're hitting diminishing returns and wasting budget.

facts.fact: The page says CTV typically delivers 90-97% video completion rates because ads are non-skippable.
facts.quote: CTV typically delivers 90-97% completion rates because ads are non-skippable.

facts.fact: The page says a video completion rate below 85% signals a problem with the creative or placement.
facts.quote: If your VCR drops below 85%, something is wrong with the creative or placement.

facts.fact: The page states political CTV CPMs typically range from $20 to $45, depending on targeting specificity and market competitiveness.
facts.quote: typically range from $20-$45, depending on targeting specificity and market competitiveness.

facts.fact: The page states battleground state CPMs can run 30-50% higher than non-competitive markets during peak election windows.
facts.quote: Battleground state CPMs can run 30-50% higher than non-competitive markets during peak election windows.

facts.fact: The page gives an example that in a market with 500,000 TV households, 100 GRPs equals 500,000 impressions.
facts.quote: In a market with 500,000 TV households, 100 GRPs equals 500,000 impressions (100% of the audience reached once).

facts.fact: The page gives an example that if a target audience of voters 35-64 is 45% of a market, 100 GRPs among adults 18+ might equal 220 TRPs among that target.
facts.quote: If your campaign targets voters 35-64 and they represent 45% of a market, 100 GRPs among adults 18+ might equal 220 TRPs among your target.

facts.fact: The page is dated April 11, 2026.
The vendor's CTV benchmark table rates a political CTV campaign's CPM as below average when it is above $45, average at $30-45, strong at $20-30, and elite below $20.
The vendor's CTV benchmark table rates video completion rate of 95% or higher as elite for political campaigns.
facts.quote: | Video completion rate | Below 85% | 85-90% | 90-95% | 95%+ |

facts.fact: The vendor's CTV benchmark table rates branded search lift of 50% or higher as elite for political campaigns.
facts.quote: | Branded search lift | Below 10% | 10-25% | 25-50% | 50%+ |

facts.fact: The vendor's broadcast benchmark table rates local-market cost per GRP above $150 as below average, $75-150 as average, and below $75 as strong.
facts.quote: | Cost per GRP (local market) | Above $150 | $75-150 | Below $75 |

facts.fact: The vendor's broadcast benchmark table rates weekly persuasion GRPs of 400-600 as strong and below 200 as below average.
facts.quote: | Weekly GRPs (persuasion) | Below 200 | 200-400 | 400-600 |

facts.fact: The vendor states a well-executed cross-channel political buy should reach 60-80% of registered voters in the target geography at least 3 times across all channels combined.
facts.quote: A well-executed cross-channel political media buy should reach 60-80% of registered voters in the target geography at least 3 times across all channels combined.

facts.fact: The vendor states that reaching 80% or more of target voters at 5+ frequency represents elite-level saturation.
facts.quote: Reaching 80%+ at 5+ frequency represents elite-level saturation.

facts.fact: The vendor states to expect 20-35% audience overlap between broadcast and CTV.
facts.quote: Expect 20-35% audience overlap between broadcast and CTV.

facts.fact: The vendor cites Video Advertising Bureau research finding voters exposed to both broadcast and CTV show 22% higher recall than those exposed to one channel alone.
facts.quote: Research from the Video Advertising Bureau shows that voters exposed on both broadcast and CTV show 22% higher recall and 18% higher favorability lift

facts.fact: The vendor cites Video Advertising Bureau research finding voters exposed to both broadcast and CTV show 18% higher favorability lift than those exposed to one channel alone.
facts.quote: voters exposed on both broadcast and CTV show 22% higher recall and 18% higher favorability lift than those exposed on one channel alone.

facts.fact: The vendor states competitive congressional campaigns average $3-8 per reached voter across all channels combined.
facts.quote: competitive congressional campaigns average $3-8 per reached voter (all impressions included).

facts.fact: The vendor states state legislative races can achieve $1-4 per reached voter across all channels combined.
facts.quote: State legislative races can achieve $1-4 per reached voter because of lower market competition.

facts.fact: The vendor's typical CTV budget range for a city council or school board race is $2,000-10,000.
The vendor's typical CTV budget range for a congressional race is $50,000-250,000.
The vendor's typical CTV budget range for a statewide race is $250,000 to $1M+.
The vendor states brand lift studies typically cost $5,000-20,000 per study.
facts.quote: These typically cost $5,000-20,000 per study, making them accessible for congressional races and above.

facts.fact: The vendor states Kantar subscriptions typically start at $10,000-25,000 per cycle for political clients.
facts.quote: Kantar subscriptions typically start at $10,000-25,000 per cycle for political clients.

facts.fact: The vendor states voter file matching services such as L2 Political and TargetSmart typically cost $0.02-0.05 per matched record for CTV campaigns.
facts.quote: typically at $0.02-0.05 per matched record.

facts.fact: The vendor states professional tracking polls run $5,000-15,000 per wave for local and state races.
facts.quote: Professional tracking polls run $5,000-15,000 per wave for local and state races.

facts.fact: The vendor states online panel surveys cost $1,000-3,000 per wave as a lower-cost alternative to professional tracking polls.
facts.quote: Online panel surveys offer a lower-cost alternative at $1,000-3,000 per wave.

facts.fact: According to the American Association of Political Consultants, roughly 40% of political campaigns skip baseline measurement.
facts.quote: roughly 40% of political campaigns skip baseline measurement according to the AAPC (American Association of Political Consultants).

facts.fact: The page advises expanding targeting rather than saturating the same voters if CTV frequency exceeds 15 per household.
facts.quote: If CTV frequency exceeds 15 per household, expand targeting rather than saturating the same voters.

facts.fact: The page recommends shifting 10-20% of an underperforming channel's budget toward a channel that significantly outperforms it.
facts.quote: shift 10-20% of underperforming channel budget toward the winner.

facts.fact: The page advises evaluating creative messaging before cutting budget if polling shows no movement after 4 weeks of TV.
facts.quote: if polling shows no movement after 4 weeks of TV, evaluate the creative messaging before cutting budget.

facts.fact: The page recommends reporting channel-level delivery metrics weekly, outcome metrics bi-weekly, and polling or brand lift results monthly.
facts.quote: Report on channel-level delivery metrics weekly, outcome metrics (search trends, website traffic, donations) bi-weekly, and polling or brand lift results monthly.

facts.fact: Adwave's FAQ states that campaigns at any level can access its measurement infrastructure starting at $50.
facts.quote: Starting at just $50, campaigns at any level can access the same measurement infrastructure

facts.fact: The page cites industry best practice of allocating 5-10% of total media budget to measurement and analytics.
facts.quote: Industry best practice is to allocate 5-10% of your total media budget to measurement and analytics.

facts.fact: The page states that 100 GRPs in a market of 500,000 TV households equals roughly 500,000 impressions.
facts.quote: One hundred GRPs in a market of 500,000 TV households equals roughly 500,000 impressions.

facts.fact: The page states that branded search lift typically becomes measurable within 1-2 weeks of launching a CTV campaign.
facts.quote: Branded search lift typically becomes measurable in 1-2 weeks of launching a CTV campaign.

facts.fact: The page states that polling-based measurements such as name recognition and favorability require 3-4 weeks to show statistically significant movement.
facts.quote: Polling-based measurements (name recognition, favorability) require 3-4 weeks to show statistically significant movement.

facts.fact: The page recommends planning for at least a 4-week flight to generate meaningful cross-channel performance data.
facts.quote: Plan for at least a 4-week flight to generate meaningful cross-channel performance data.

facts.fact: The page states that CTV can produce statistically significant creative A/B test results in days, rather than requiring separate broadcast flights.
facts.quote: have statistically significant results in days.
